additional_info.subject: Note to RC
additional_info.body:
The customer reported this issue in another ticket for the same charger-→We had previously reported a similar issue under the ticket Request for Ticket Creation for Sicharge D Station - Connector DC1 CRM:02023000341.
In this specific case, the Volvo FH Electric truck fails to start charging sessions. After multiple attempts, one session eventually started but stopped prematurely. The truck was moved to the Volvo Trucks center in Le Havre, where it successfully charged on a 40 kW DC mobile charger without any issues.
It is critical to analyze the root cause of this malfunction, determine whether it originates from the charger, and implement the necessary corrective measures promptly.
Details of Failed Sessions:
1.    Failed Session
•     Duration: 00:00:20
•     Start: 27/11/2024 13:54:32
•     End: 27/11/2024 13:54:53
•     Delivered Energy: 0.4 kWh
2.    Failed Session
•     Duration: 00:00:22
•     Start: 27/11/2024 13:26:00
•     End: 27/11/2024 13:26:22
•     Delivered Energy: 0.4 kWh
Observations of Recurring Errors:
•     27/11/2024 14:30:38
•     Error in internal hard- or software component
•     Charger: FR*AU10058-01
•     Connector: 3 (CCS plug)
Following the advice of your colleague Emmanuel NEVO, we restarted the charger, but the issue persists, continuing to trigger errors.
I would like to provide some additional information regarding the ongoing issue with the Sicharge D station.
David, the director of the Trucks Center in Le Havre, shared some relevant details with us. Attached, you will find screenshots of the charger errors from Duboc. Additionally, please find below the active fault displayed in One View:
See attached file
Please let me know if you need any further information or clarification to expedite the resolution of this issue.
I kindly request your immediate attention to this matter and look forward to your guidance on the next steps to resolve this critical issue.
